arg.name: map_path
arg.description: The twin's map directory: lanelet2_map.osm, pointcloud_map/ with pointcloud_map_metadata.yaml, map_projector_info.yaml (MGRS 51RUH). Required.

arg.name: imu_source
arg.description: xsens: the sim publishes /sensing/imu/xsens/imu_raw in imu_link. It has no ZED IMU and no zed_imu_link frame, so zed does not work here.

arg.name: data_path
arg.description: Autoware's model directory, writable (TensorRT caches engines there). Defaults to $AUTOWARE_DATA, else ./data/autoware_data from the repository root. Without it CenterPoint does not load.

arg.name: speed_limit
arg.description: Planning speed default in m/s (golfcart_launch's planning_speed_limit.py, latched). 2.5 is the demo cap; empty keeps Autoware's max_vel.

arg.name: camera_model
arg.description: none: Isaac publishes the camera topics itself. The sensor kit starts its GMSL camera nodes whatever launch_driver says, and they die with no nvv4l2camerasrc off the cart.

arg.name: rviz
arg.description: The twin demo RViz (rviz/twin_demo.rviz) with the vehicle parameters and sim time
